class.name: GDScriptStruct
class.brief_description: Metadata for a named GDScript [code]struct[/code] type.
class.description:
Holds the field layout of a GDScript [code]struct[/code] declared with the [code]struct[/code] keyword. Runtime struct values are typed arrays with named members; [GDScriptStruct] describes that layout so the compiler, inspector, and scripts can inspect field names, types, and defaults. Declare a struct in GDScript and construct values with the type name: [codeblock] struct Stats: var hp: int = 100 var speed: float = 1.0
func _ready() -> void: var s := Stats(50, 2.0) s.hp += 10 [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Script authors normally work with struct values directly. [GDScriptStruct] is the type-definition object, not the runtime value.

method.name: get_fields
